note: The growth step of the hourly tick (docs 10, 11). habitat: how the 1 m habitat grid is built from the water summary: moisture falls from fresh water to nothing over bankM; the tide band holds at least bandMoisture and bandSalt (0..255); salt falls from the sea and band over saltM. grass: painting decides where grass is at once; the grass cover per cell (how well grass likes the ground) follows the ground slowly, moving toward its target by ratePerH of the gap each game hour, so a dug pond drowns its grass over about a day and drained ground greens again; grass thins in standing water and on salty ground (saltFrom: thinning starts, saltFull: none from this salt up), and gives way where rushes stand: its target falls by yieldToCover times the rushes' share; grass.habitat: the ground axes grass asks for, as in reeds.json (earth rather than sand or rock, no steeper than about 35 degrees). maxPlants caps the individual plants on the island. starters: the species a new island starts with (with grass). Every other species, plant or cover, arrives later by itself as a volunteer (src/world/growth/volunteers.js): volunteers.order is the order they come in (one the island has no ground for yet is skipped until it has), none in the island's first firstAfterH game hours, at least gapH hours between two, then a chance of chancePerH each hour; it lands, as a sprout or a new tussock, on a square it likes at least minSuit. The journal notes the first one and the Plant tool offers it from then on. species: the flora recipes that grow (recipes/flora/<id>.json); pondweed is in neither starters nor volunteers: it comes only as the minnows' gift of seed. cover: cover plants other than grass (recipes/flora/<id>.json, layer cover): each keeps a share per square meter that moves toward how well it likes the ground, like the grass cover. marks: the Plant tool's rings on the ground (UI only): each planted seed gets a ring that grows from tapRadiusM[0] to [1] and fades over tapS seconds; while the tool is open, the player's plantings that are not yet mature carry a youngRadiusM ring at youngOpacity (at most 15, the newest first). A living thing tapped with no tool chosen (the journal's card) gets a ring that blooms in over selectBloomS seconds, then breathes: its radius swells by selectPulse and its opacity moves between selectOpacity over selectPulseS seconds; the ring's size comes from recipes/world/journal.json identify.ringM.
